summary: My project, ASTRALACE, is a Mars Survival Explorer created for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. It aims to make exploring Mars more interesting through interactive maps and features that help users understand its surface and environment. I chose this project because I’ve always been curious about space and the possibility of humans living on other planets. I believe studying Mars is important because it helps us understand the challenges of future space exploration and prepare for possible human missions. Through ASTRALACE, I hope to make learning about Mars easier, more engaging and accessible to everyone.
details: Astralace is a project I created to make learning about Mars more interesting and engaging. It allows users to explore Mars, learn about its surface and understand the challenges astronauts might face in the future. I wanted to make space exploration easier to understand through an interactive experience rather than just text. I developed it using a website-building platform and online resources. I focused on making the project informative, accessible and visually interesting while considering scientific accuracy and the needs of future space explorers.
